summary: Telemetry setup [GAP: Native providers and lifecycle]; runAgent [GAP: Agent root and orchestration] -> retrieval [GAP: Local retrieval content] -> lookupOrder [GAP: Order tool content and failures] -> actual model HTTP [GAP: HTTP model lifecycle and content]; model measurements [GAP: Inference latency and observed usage]; agent/tool measurements [GAP: Agent and tool metrics and token distributions]; selected local Project [GAP: Runtime Project resolution] -> Agent Stream [GAP: Dedicated runtime Agent Stream resolution] -> trace export [GAP: Native trace routing and recovery].

evidence.finding: Native OTel libraries/exporters are declared, but dependencies alone are not active instrumentation.
Main builds the app, calls the no-op telemetry factory, runs source scenarios, then calls shutdown.
The client calls a numeric-loopback /model endpoint; the app has no inbound HTTP route.
Observe is initially nil; the telemetry factory returns a no-op shutdown. The app owns its HTTP client and business JSON output.

findings.title: Native providers and lifecycle
findings.gap: configureTelemetry returns a no-op and leaves Observe nil; all signals have no provider/exporter or effective endpoint.
findings.impact: No trace or metric can be received or drained.
findings.product_outcome: Operators should receive native traces and metrics with stable service identity.
findings.required_fix: Native traces/metrics initialize and shut down through the existing configureTelemetry/Observe seams, preserving operator configuration, app lifecycle and one export owner.
acceptance_criteria: Native traces/metrics initialize and shut down through the existing configureTelemetry/Observe seams, preserving operator configuration, app lifecycle and one export owner.
constraints: Preserve existing business behavior and telemetry ownership; keep private data and unbounded identities out of telemetry dimensions.
No Python sidecar, speculative AO package or second trace creator. Preserve production independence from eval/report artifacts.

expected_telemetry.product_view: Operators should receive native traces and metrics with stable service identity.

findings.title: Native trace routing and recovery
findings.gap: There is no exporter or consumed Studio profile, no actual resource-bound headers and no trace Resource binding or recovery path.
findings.impact: Agent traces cannot be reliably routed while business execution stays independent.
findings.product_outcome: Operators should see complete agent traces in the selected destination after routing is verified.
